fields.value: Enhancing specific capacitance and energy density in printed supercapacitors: The role of activated wood carbon and electrolyte dynamics

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset corresponds to the paper titled above is funded by the European Commission's Horizon Europe programme and is part of the Graphene Flagship initiative. It consists of a single Origin file containing multiple sheets with comprehensive experimental data. The dataset includes CV and GCD curves for supercapacitors fabricated using different AWC and YP-80F carbon materials at operating voltages of 1.0 V and 1.2 V. Additionally, it provides characterized performance values such as capacitance, ESR, leakage current, and energy density for both voltage conditions.

This dataset was generated using a Maccor 4300 workstation (Maccor Inc., USA) and a Zahner Zennium potentiostat to characterize the fabricated supercapacitors.

The .opju format data was converted to open formats with 10.5281/zenodo.15300716.
